title: Re: Our plan for next year

messages.author: S. Raghavan (Appa)
messages.body:
Dear Meera, Kiran, Divya and all,

Amma and I have been discussing this for some weeks and we have now decided. From next year we will spend the summer months with Meera in Leicester and the rest of the year here in Bangalore as usual. Meera has started preparing our long-term visitor visa application with the agent, ready to submit in January. If all is well we will fly in the first week of April and return end of September, before the Bangalore rains finish.

We are not selling the flat. Lakshmi will continue to come for the cleaning and Venkatesh will collect the rent from the shop downstairs.

We wanted to tell everybody together so there is no confusion. Amma says she will carry her own pickles, so Meera need not worry.

With blessings,
Appa

messages.author: Divya Raghavan
messages.body:
Oh this is lovely news!! Anika and Rohan are going to lose their minds. Amma please also carry the murukku achu, I have been trying to find one in Pune for ages and if you are going to be in England with Meera's big kitchen you have no excuse.

Kiran is travelling till Sunday, he will reply separately.

Love,
Divya

messages.author: Kiran Raghavan
messages.body:
Appa, Amma,

I am happy for you if this is what you want. But I have to say this came as a surprise to me and I would have liked to be asked before the visa paperwork was already under way. Meera, I'm assuming this has been in discussion for some time between you and them.

My concerns, and I'm putting them plainly so nobody says later I didn't:

1. Appa's heart. His angioplasty was only last year. Dr. Prakash knows his case, and from what I understand visitors don't get free NHS treatment. What happens if something happens over there?
2. Six months is a long time for Amma away from her own house and her own people. She hasn't stayed anywhere longer than six weeks since Paati died.
3. We were planning to have them in Pune for Ganesh Chaturthi next year. Now that is gone.

I'm not trying to spoil anything. I just think this needed more discussion than an email on a Saturday morning.

Kiran
